instruments.name: Arp Blip
instruments.description: A 25% pulse that snaps shut almost at once, made for fast chip arpeggios that fake a chord.

instruments.name: Glide Lead
instruments.description: A single-note filtered sawtooth that slides between notes, for expressive solos and bends.

instruments.name: Triangle Bass
instruments.description: The soft, round triangle bass of the NES, with a short release so lines stay tight.

instruments.name: Sub Bass
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Acid Bass
instruments.description: A squelchy, resonant sawtooth with a snapping filter and glide, in the spirit of the TB-303.

instruments.name: Soft Pad
instruments.description: Detuned fat triangles that swell in slowly and linger, for chords behind a melody.

instruments.name: Chip Kit
instruments.description: A whole chiptune drum machine in one instrument: kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, crash, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes, with the closed hat choking the open one.

instruments.name: 8-Bit Triangle
instruments.description: A bare triangle wave straight off the oscillator with no filter and no envelope shaping, the way Online Sequencer plays it.

instruments.name: House Kit
instruments.description: A punchy 909-style dance machine: a short, thick kick and a deeper, longer one, a hard snare, a big clap, crisp hats that choke each other, toms, rim, crash, ride, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes.
